# ADR-3032: A03: Xpath concat for XML lookup 8

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

XPath injection bypasses access filters.

## Decision

XML services SHALL NOT build an xpath concat for XML lookup 8 (A03-8) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Bind variables through the XML API.
